notes.title: Launch!! And some bugs 🐛
notes.notes:
It's so exciting to finally release ProtoDungeon Episode I on Steam. I appreciate everyone who has supported me and played and encouraged me. 

I wanted to provide a quick update! I tested everything successfully on an older version of macOS (12 I think). Unfortunately the Mac version will need an update to run on modern OSes. This is more complicated than it sounds because the build is very old, the project files aren't compatible with the current version of my engine, and I can't export from an older version because my license doesn't support that. SO! I will be attempting a more manual conversion to get the Mac up and running. Thanks for your patience here. 

The good news is players have confirmed the game runs great on the Deck! Not a surprise, but still a relief (you never know with these things).

Enjoy the game and I'll see y'all soon, hopefully with a patch for my Mac friends!
